info.title: Subpolar HTTP API
info.description: Same-origin JSON API for the Subpolar browser service. JSON objects are closed: unknown request keys are rejected. Authenticated responses are not cacheable. State-changing browser requests require an exact Origin, X-CSRF-Token, and Idempotency-Key unless the operation is bootstrap or login. X-Request-Id is an optional UUIDv4 and is returned in errors and the response header when supplied or generated.

503.description: The server is not ready to accept work.

get.summary: Report whether the first administrator is required

post.summary: Create the first administrator and browser session
post.description: Only succeeds while no user exists. The exact request Origin is required. Success sets both authentication cookies.
The exact request Origin is required. Login failures use a generic error and do not identify which credential check failed. Success sets both authentication cookies.

post.summary: Rotate the authenticated password and session
post.description: Password rotation revokes all existing sessions and sets one fresh session. The plaintext password is never returned.

get.summary: Return first-run setup status without secrets

get.description: Provider metadata only. Credentials and configured secrets are never returned.

post.description: The API key is write-only and is never returned in JSON, events, transcripts, idempotency responses, or logs.

get.summary: List projects owned by the authenticated user
List agents owned by the authenticated user
List sessions owned by the authenticated user
Read an owned session and its typed messages

post.description: The request is a closed object. Non-streaming responses are JSON. Streaming responses are Server-Sent Events containing versioned event envelopes in order, followed by exactly one data: [DONE] record after a terminal event. Idempotency-Key is not accepted for streaming requests.

get.summary: Upgrade to the authenticated Subpolar event stream
get.description: The upgrade is a same-origin WebSocket request authenticated by subpolar_session. Frames are UTF-8 JSON text. The first server event is the connected event. Every chat.start command must include the readable subpolar_csrf cookie value in csrfToken; chat.start uses the same idempotency rule as state-changing HTTP requests. Unknown commands, unknown fields, and binary frames are rejected.

sessionCookie.name: subpolar_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque random session credential. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, and Secure in HTTPS production deployments. Only its hash is persisted.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly equal the configured public origin. Missing, opaque, cross-origin, and suffix-matching values are rejected.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Must equal both the subpolar_csrf cookie and the server-side value for the session.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: ASCII key, at most 255 characters, scoped to the principal, method, path, and operation version. A matching key and request hash replays the original typed response; a different hash conflicts.

OptionalIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
OptionalIdempotencyKey.description: Use for non-streaming chat retries. Streaming requests must omit this header because replay is not supported for an event stream.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Optional client UUIDv4. The server generates one when absent and returns it in the response header and error envelope.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding list response.

AuthCookies.description: Two Set-Cookie fields are emitted: subpolar_session and subpolar_csrf. Both use Path=/, Max-Age=604800, and SameSite=Lax; Secure is added for HTTPS. The session cookie is HttpOnly; the CSRF cookie is readable and is not HttpOnly.

RequestId.description: The server-generated or client-supplied UUIDv4 correlation ID.

ClearedAuthCookies.description: Both subpolar_session and subpolar_csrf are cleared with Max-Age=0, Path=/, and the same SameSite and Secure policy used when issued.

Unauthorized.description: No active session cookie authenticated the request.

Forbidden.description: The resource is not owned by the authenticated user.

OriginRejected.description: The request Origin is missing or is not the exact configured origin.

CsrfOrOriginRejected.description: The exact Origin or CSRF checks failed.

ForbiddenOrCsrfRejected.description: The request failed an ownership, exact Origin, or CSRF check.

BootstrapFailed.description: Bootstrap validation failed or an administrator already exists.

ChatRequestFailed.description: The chat request was rejected or provider execution failed.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The idempotency key conflicts with a prior request or is already in progress.

ServerDraining.description: The server is draining and is not accepting new work.

UpgradeFailed.description: The WebSocket upgrade could not be completed.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the owner.

ChatEventStream.description: UTF-8 text/event-stream. Each event record is data: followed by an EventEnvelope JSON object and a blank line. The stream ends with exactly one data: [DONE] record after a terminal EventEnvelope.
